sectionContext.speaker: Matt Dillahunty
sectionContext.claim: When known candidate causes fail, ignorance of a cause does not make God a plausible explanation.
sectionContext.warrant: Matches and blowtorches are grounded causes of a burning table; if investigation finds none, 'we do not know' remains preferable to a cause that has not itself been shown possible.
sectionContext.inference: Explanatory sufficiency or the absence of rivals cannot substitute for independent warrant that the proposed cause is a live candidate.

sectionContext.speaker: Matt Dillahunty
